verdict.rationale: Unleash documents per-environment flag configurations, so a flag can be enabled in development or test without being enabled in production. Backend tokens scoped to a single environment let a client or agent be confined to a non-production environment, and a self-hosted Docker instance can also serve as a separate test setup. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox instance or data-isolation guarantees beyond flag configuration, documentation of environment scoping for the MCP/agent workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.
Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.
Environments represent different stages in your development lifecycle. They allow you to manage your product releases from local development to production.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
